items.title: X post from @oscarpiastri81: Oscar on missing the intensity of a championship fight despite a more relaxed season, via @Raci…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarpiastri81：Oscar谈尽管赛季更轻松但仍怀念冠军争夺的紧张感，via @Racingnews365：“如果可以，我想每年都参与冠军争夺，但今年也确实轻松了一些。显然，我们并不想处于这个位置，但压力没那么大了。“但你在冠军争夺中感受到的那种压力正是你想要的感觉，因为那意味着你在为你目标中的东西而战。今年我确实怀念那种感觉，它会带来一些额外的紧张感之类的。“但是的，也不是全都……当你不在冠军争夺中时，有些事情会稍微容易一些。”[via @mesandor 和 @ianparkesf1]
items.summary: Oscar on missing the intensity of a championship fight despite a more relaxed season, via @Racingnews365: “I want to be in a championship fight every year if I can be, but also, it's definitely a bit more relaxed this year. Obviously, we're not wanting to be in this position, but there's not quite the same stress. “But that stress that you have in a championship fight is the feeling you want because it means you're fighting for something that is what your goal is. I am missing that feeling this year for sure, and it adds a bit of extra intensity and things like that. “But yeah, it's not all... there are some things that are a little bit easier when you're not in a championship.” [via @mesandor and @ianparkesf1]
items.summary_zh: Oscar谈尽管赛季更轻松但仍怀念冠军争夺的紧张感，via @Racingnews365：“如果可以，我想每年都参与冠军争夺，但今年也确实轻松了一些。显然，我们并不想处于这个位置，但压力没那么大了。“但你在冠军争夺中感受到的那种压力正是你想要的感觉，因为那意味着你在为你目标中的东西而战。今年我确实怀念那种感觉，它会带来一些额外的紧张感之类的。“但是的，也不是全都……当你不在冠军争夺中时，有些事情会稍微容易一些。”[via @mesandor 和 @ianparkesf1]
